description: the shared preset frame and bytes extend (`github>dvakatsiienko/frame//renovate/default`); a repo's own renovate.json keeps only its holds and its own managers

packageRules.description: toolchain pins are owned by `pnpm toolchain:sync` (installed node + pnpm are the truth): .node-version, packageManager and engines never move here — #41 re-pinned node to a patch fnm did not have
same contract for the manifest fields
patches: one grouped pr overnight, automerged once ci is green; a repo whose merge deploys prod narrows the merge with its own automergeSchedule
minors: one grouped pr on wednesday 07:00–12:00, merged by hand; the window is wide so a late hourly cron still lands in it
majors open no pr: they wait on the dependency dashboard for the major round, which cclio runs on dima's word

0.x never automerges: semver lets a 0.x package break in a patch, so these ride the wednesday pr for a human to read. last rule on purpose — later rules win, so this overrides the patch tier above. matchCurrentVersion prefers the locked version, so it catches a 0.x behind a range too. a 0.x → 1.0 is a major and stays on the dashboard.
